subject: words
title: Soft c: ce and se
about: CKLA Unit 6: c can say s before e or i (cent, pencil) and the endings ce and se also say s (dance, house). Unit 6 calls c a tricky spelling.
tip: If a word starts with c-e or c-i, try the s sound first.
